title: [SOA] Fix missing Agent Task Message read permission in contact search
summary: SOA Contact Search Impl now has read permission for Agent Task Message, allowing the Sales Order Agent to complete contact-mapping flows without permission intervention.
key_points: Added read permission for Agent Task Message table
Prevents AR-PERMISSION intervention when opening Contacts list during agent workflow
Enables the contact-mapping flow to query the latest input task message
No changes to contact matching, filtering, or data persistence
Low-risk permission addition for existing data access
quote: Add read permission for Agent Task Message to SOA Contact Search Impl.
